UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public profile metadata for an authenticated InsightBoard VDB user.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Display name of the authenticated user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

SavedReport.title: SavedReport
SavedReport.description: Aggregate BI and shopping mall dashboard report snapshot owned by an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the report owner.

recordCount.description: Count of filtered records in the snapshot.

summary.description: AI or analytical executive summary text.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the report was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the report was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/reports/{reportId}.description: Saved dashboard report snapshots scoped strictly to ownerId.
